description: Shows the add-ons a workspace can buy for all its projects (such as using its own domain on previews, or taking the CodeGene badge off its videos), with their prices, what each does and whether the workspace already has it (held), and returns each one's settingsUrl: the CodeGene page where the person agrees to the Terms and pays. It buys nothing and you cannot buy for them: quote the prices exactly as returned and give the person the link. Only a workspace owner or admin can buy (canBuy says whether this person can). Use it when the person asks what they can add, or another tool answers that the workspace needs an add-on.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: start_add_on
